features.description: Improve scoped React UI behavior, language consistency, accessibility, and presentation without changing unsupported factual claims.
features.evidence: 2026-09-18: A–H remediation/polish merged and pre-demo verified. 156 catalogue routes/views resolve to six UI families; URL navigation, tab accessibility, lazy loading, Data Trust hierarchy, geography correctness, and representative family normalization are covered by desktop/mobile E2E. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and the full desktop/mobile Playwright suite. Post-demo Batch 03 / Registry Social A is implemented in PR #15: eight social-service/public-directory routes now use the shared registry frame and heading; the two existing multi-view routes use AccessibleTabs while six single-view routes remain single-view. Existing search/filter behavior, fetch paths, contact/map actions, summaries, tables, pagination, CSV export, charts, notices, and data interpretation are unchanged. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 97 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 04 / Registry Social B is implemented in PR #16: seven additional social-welfare/care/childcare registry routes now use the shared family shell; generated directories opt in only where needed, and the community-childcare route remains a single combined view after removing non-functional faux tabs. Existing filtering, pagination, exports, capacity semantics, maps/external lookups, charts, tables, notices, and domain/data behavior are preserved. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 99 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 05 / Registry Social C is implemented in PR #17: six additional social/community/childcare registry routes now use the shared family shell; five genuine multi-view pages use AccessibleTabs while the child/youth residential-placement page remains a single combined view after removing non-functional faux tabs. Existing filtering, pagination, exports, capacity/evaluation semantics, maps/external lookups, charts, tables, notices, and domain/data interpretation are preserved. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 101 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 06 / Registry Culture and Pets is implemented in PR #18: nine culture/arts/animal-care registry routes now use the shared family shell; seven dedicated multi-view modules use AccessibleTabs and two generated directories opt into the shared family wrapper. Existing filters, cross-dataset comparisons, maps/district summaries, pagination, exports, matching semantics, veterinary disclaimers, charts, tables, notices, and domain/data interpretation are preserved. After tightening the new E2E heading assertion to exact matching, Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 103 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 07 / Registry City Services is implemented in PR #19: ten city-service/environmental/funeral/public-contact registry routes now use the shared family shell; four dedicated multi-view modules use AccessibleTabs, three single-view modules remain tab-free, and three generated directories opt into the family wrapper. Two non-functional waste-oil faux tabs were removed. Existing filters, pagination, exports, summaries, contact actions, comparisons, source notices, tables, charts, and domain/data interpretation are otherwise preserved. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 105 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 08 / Records Compliance is implemented in PR #20: `laborPensionActViolations`, `oshViolations`, and `genderEqualityViolations` now use the shared records-analysis family shell based on the Labor Standards Act reference. OSH and gender-equality use AccessibleTabs while Labor Pension remains a real single-view page without invented tabs. Existing filters, summaries, timelines, provision/category/fine analysis, comparisons, record tables, notices, default inclusion/exclusion rules, and domain/data interpretation are preserved. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 107 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 09 / Records General is implemented in PR #21: eight general-record routes now use the shared records-analysis family shell; six genuine multi-view pages use AccessibleTabs while education-volunteer recognition and lodging-penalty records remain real single-view pages without invented tabs. Existing filters, nearby/geolocation behavior, maps, trends, comparisons, summaries, pagination, exports, source notices, penalty/amount semantics, tables, and domain/data interpretation are preserved. The initial new E2E exceeded its per-test timeout because routes were revisited in multiple loops; the coverage was consolidated to one pass per route, after which Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 109 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 10 / Statistics Evaluations is implemented in PR #22: six evaluation/statistics routes use the shared statistics-analysis shell; historical evaluation data remains source-scoped. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 111 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 11 / Statistics Analysis is implemented in PR #23: six analysis/statistics routes use the shared statistics-analysis shell; two genuine multi-view pages use AccessibleTabs and four single-view pages remain tab-free. Frontend CI passed typecheck, unit tests, production build, and Playwright with 113 passed, 1 expected skip, 0 failed. Post-demo Batch 12 / Location Social is implemented and merged in PR #24: six social-service location routes use the shared location-directory shell; five multi-view pages use AccessibleTabs and one combined-view page has its non-functional faux tabs removed. Final CI was still in progress when Batch 13 began, so no final Batch 12 CI result is asserted here.
